reading: The model pool and search are small enough for a laptop. Conclusions apply to this panel and candidate pool, not to the paper's full benchmark.

reading: The diagonal marks a perfect estimate. Above it, CV was optimistic. Closeness to the diagonal need not imply selecting the best model.

reading: Lower MASE, MAPEE and regret are better. Optimism is the fraction of the three candidate errors underestimated per seed. The oracle is restricted to the same final model pool.
section: Estimating error versus choosing a model

caption: Paired downstream differences at rho=0.7.
reading: Five-fold mean delta is 0.0027; its conditional series-bootstrap 95% interval is [0.0010, 0.0049]. Models, selectors and Q stay fixed. Shared shocks and refitting uncertainty are excluded.

caption: Known and unseen series are scored separately with the same Q.
alt: Known and unseen series are scored separately with the same Q.
reading: The unseen stratum has higher mean loss in 1 of 3 time-holdout partitions (seeds: 456). The aggregate bars hide that variation. These different series groups do not identify a causal penalty from exclusion; all strata share the run's Q.

caption: Logical fits and local CPU fitting time; common final models are trained once per condition.
alt: Logical fits and local CPU fitting time; common final models are trained once per condition.
reading: Five-fold CV spends more fits and trains on fewer series per outer fit. These are whole-procedure comparisons, not isolated measurements of the effect of series separation.
